name: Wonderbook Tea Party
source:
Take a short personality test to find out which of the five Wonders of Wonderbook you are most similar to!

Are you curious like Bumble the Black Bear? Fun like Toodle the Sun Bear? Protective like Marron the Brown Bear? Observant like Pippin the Polar Bear? Supportive like Jamble the Panda Bear?

This personality test is given by Jamble himself! Maybe something special will happen if you get his personality?

Only one way to find out!!

[[url=https://wednesday888.itch.io/wonderbook-tea-party]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来做个简短的性格测试，看看你与《奇妙绘本》里的五位奇妙小熊伙伴中哪一位最相似吧！

你是像黑熊邦布尔一样充满好奇心？像马来熊图德尔一样活泼爱玩？像棕熊玛隆一样富有保护欲？像北极熊皮平一样善于观察？还是像大熊猫詹布尔一样体贴可靠呢？

这场性格测试将由詹布尔亲自为你主持！要是你测出了和它一样的性格，说不定还会发生什么特别的事哦？

想揭晓答案，就快来亲自试试看吧！！

[摘自[url=https://wednesday888.itch.io/wonderbook-tea-party]itch.io[/url]]
